summary_en: Annual dividend per share raised to 52 yen from 51 yen for fiscal year ending February 2027, reflecting upward revision of net profit forecast to 3,550 million yen. Payout ratio maintained at approximately 31.0% of earnings.
title_en: Notice of Revisions to Business Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
CREEK & RIVER Co., Ltd. raised its annual dividend per share for the fiscal year ending February 28, 2027 to 52 yen from the previously forecast 51 yen. The interim dividend remains at 0 yen, while the year-end dividend increases to 52 yen from the prior forecast of 51 yen. The company's net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was revised upward to 3,550 million yen from 3,450 million yen, reflecting solid performance in its core creative services division in Japan and medical field, as well as steady progress in Takahashi Shoten Group, acquired as a consolidated subsidiary in March 2025.

The company maintains a basic dividend policy targeting a consolidated payout ratio of approximately 30%, balancing shareholder returns with internal reserves to strengthen its operational foundation and withstand changes in the business environment. Based on the upward earnings revision, the 1-yen increase reflects this earnings-linked approach while remaining within the company's target payout ratio range of approximately 31.0%.
